title: Former Cowboys edge rusher Marshawn Kneeland diagnosed with CTE after death at age 24

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Former Cowboys edge rusher Marshawn Kneeland diagnosed with CTE after death at age 24
sources.description: Researchers diagnosed Kneeland with stage 1 CTE following a postmortem brain analysis, his family and the Concussion & CTE Foundation announced
